title: Standing Architectural Rules & Ledger Schema
description: General JSON Schema defining standing architectural rules, Firebase security invariants, and verification contracts for mechanical issue ledgers.

$schema.description: URI or relative path of the schema governing this document.

title.description: Imperative summary of the architectural violation or defect.

screenshot.description: Optional artifact filename or URL of the visual evidence/review.

rule.description: Canonical standing architectural rule or recognized alias being enforced.

target.description: The exact source code location containing the violation.

file.description: Relative path to the primary file under review from the project root.

secondaryFile.description: Optional relative path to a secondary file affected by the violation.

enclosingSymbol.description: Function, class, or module enclosing the target violation.

anchor.description: Contextual anchor to locate the code snippet precisely.

violation.description: The defect narrative and required architectural remediation.

problem.description: Detailed explanation of what rule is violated and why.

expectedSolution.description: The exact architectural remediation required to close the issue.

forbiddenPatterns.description: Strings or tokens that MUST NOT appear in the target files for the issue to be marked fixed.

requiredPatterns.description: Strings or tokens that MUST appear in the target files for the issue to be marked fixed.

ALLOWLIST_NORMALIZED_SELF_LOOKUP_RULES.summary: Gate account profile creation and reads on a verified, lowercase-normalized email allowlist lookup with self-only read and no collection enumeration.
ALLOWLIST_NORMALIZED_SELF_LOOKUP_RULES.description: Any authenticated Google OAuth user can currently create and read `users/{uid}` without allowlist membership. Furthermore, allowlist documents must be keyed by lowercase email (`allowlist/{email}`), require `request.auth.token['email_verified'] == true` via `hasClaim('email')`, permit `get` only when `request.auth.token['email'].lower() == email`, deny `list` and `write`, and regenerate `studio/firestore.rules` from `studio/firestore.modules.rules`.
ALLOWLIST_NORMALIZED_SELF_LOOKUP_RULES.remediation: Import `hasClaim` from `'membership'`, define `hasVerifiedEmail()` and `isAllowlisted()` using `exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/allowlist/$(request.auth.token['email'].lower()))`, expose `/allowlist/{email}` with self-only `allow get` and `allow list, write: if false;`, gate `/users/{uid}` on `isAllowlisted()`, and resolve `studio/firestore.modules.rules` to `studio/firestore.rules`.

ALLOWLIST_MUTATION_BOUNDARY_PARITY.summary: Require `isAllowlisted()` across all user-authored Firestore collection mutations (`narrations` and `playlists`) and maintain modular build parity.
ALLOWLIST_MUTATION_BOUNDARY_PARITY.description: Gating `users/{uid}` alone leaves a privilege gap where a non-allowlisted or revoked Firebase Auth user can still directly invoke Firestore `create`, `update`, or `delete` on `narrations/{narrationId}` and `playlists/{playlistId}` if they only check `isOwner(...)`.
ALLOWLIST_MUTATION_BOUNDARY_PARITY.remediation: Require `isAllowlisted()` on `create`, `update`, and `delete` in both `match /narrations/{narrationId}` and `match /playlists/{playlistId}` in `studio/firestore.modules.rules`, then regenerate `studio/firestore.rules` via `pyric firestore rules resolve`.

ADMIN_SDK_ALLOWLIST_ENFORCEMENT.summary: Server Admin SDK token verification must enforce verified email and Firestore allowlist membership before returning a caller UID.
ADMIN_SDK_ALLOWLIST_ENFORCEMENT.description: Because `adminDb()` and `adminBucket()` bypass Firestore and Storage Security Rules completely, returning `decoded.uid` from `verifyIdToken` without checking `decoded.email_verified === true` and `adminDb().collection('allowlist').doc(email).get()` allows non-allowlisted or revoked users to trigger Gemini TTS synthesis (`POST /api/narrations`) and mutate server-managed resources.
antiPatterns:
const decoded = await adminAuth().verifyIdToken(token.trim(), true);
    return decoded.uid;
ADMIN_SDK_ALLOWLIST_ENFORCEMENT.remediation: In `verifyIdToken` (`studio/src/lib/firebase-admin.ts`), normalize `decoded.email?.trim().toLowerCase()`, verify `decoded.email_verified === true`, and confirm `(await adminDb().collection('allowlist').doc(email).get()).exists` before returning `decoded.uid`.

CLIENT_AUTH_ALLOWLIST_GATE.summary: Client AuthProvider must verify `allowlist/{email}` membership with session guarding before provisioning `users/{uid}` or mounting the signed-in shell.
CLIENT_AUTH_ALLOWLIST_GATE.description: When `onAuthStateChanged` emits a `firebaseUser`, immediately calling `upsertUserProfile` and `onSnapshot(userRef(uid))` without first verifying `allowlist/{email}` causes non-allowlisted users to enter the app shell with denied writes and unguarded async state transitions, while `SignInGate` gives no feedback that account creation is allowlist-restricted.
antiPatterns: New here? Continuing with Google creates your account.
CLIENT_AUTH_ALLOWLIST_GATE.remediation: Guard the async auth transition with a session counter (`loadSessionRef.current++`), check `isEmailAllowlisted(nextUser.email)` against `allowlist/{email}` before calling `upsertUserProfile` or attaching `onSnapshot`, sign out non-allowlisted users (`await signOut(auth())`), expose `accessDenied` on `AuthState`, and render an explicit allowlist denial notice in `SignInGate`.

NO_SILENT_ERROR_SWALLOWING.summary: Catch blocks must log, rethrow, or handle errors explicitly.
NO_SILENT_ERROR_SWALLOWING.description: Empty catch blocks and silent error suppression hide bugs, race conditions, and corrupted state.
NO_SILENT_ERROR_SWALLOWING.remediation: Handle expected errors with specific condition checks, or rethrow with contextual wrapping.

REQUIRE_NAMED_BOOLEANS.summary: Replace compound inline conditions with self-documenting const booleans.
REQUIRE_NAMED_BOOLEANS.description: Nested inline boolean logic increases cognitive load and hides branch conditions.
REQUIRE_NAMED_BOOLEANS.remediation: Extract conditions into descriptive variables: const hasData = data.count > 0; const isReady = res.ok && !res.pending && (hasData || forced);

NO_BOOLEAN_COERCION_CHAINS.summary: Eliminate double-negation or nested Boolean(...) coercion chains.
NO_BOOLEAN_COERCION_CHAINS.description: Chains like Boolean(Boolean(x)) or !!Boolean(x) obscure the underlying value and type contract.
NO_BOOLEAN_COERCION_CHAINS.remediation: Use explicit equality checks or a single Boolean(x) / !!x.

ATOMIC_FILE_OPERATIONS.summary: Prevent TOCTOU file system race conditions using atomic file descriptor flags.
ATOMIC_FILE_OPERATIONS.description: Checking fs.existsSync() immediately before fs.writeFileSync() creates a time-of-check to time-of-use vulnerability.
ATOMIC_FILE_OPERATIONS.remediation: Use atomic openSync with O_CREAT | O_EXCL and catch EEXIST, or write via atomic rename.

ZERO_BACKWARDS_COMPATIBILITY.summary: Zero backwards compatibility for unreleased software or deprecated internal paths.
ZERO_BACKWARDS_COMPATIBILITY.description: Retaining legacy shims, fallback paths, and compatibility layers for unreleased software introduces dead code and store bypasses.
ZERO_BACKWARDS_COMPATIBILITY.remediation: Purge legacy fallbacks completely. Standardize on the canonical store or path.
